instruction.name: xvmskltz.w
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, for each 32-bit element in `a`, set the bit at that element's index within the lane to one if the element is less than zero, otherwise zero; the remaining bits of the lane are zero.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmskltz.w $xr0, $xr8; xvmskltz.w $xr1, $xr9; xvmskltz.w $xr2, $xr10; xvmskltz.w $xr3, $xr11; xvmskltz.w $xr4, $xr12; xvmskltz.w $xr5, $xr13; xvmskltz.w $xr6, $xr14; xvmskltz.w $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvmskltz.w $xr0, $xr8; xvmskltz.w $xr1, $xr9; xvmskltz.w $xr2, $xr10; xvmskltz.w $xr3, $xr11; xvmskltz.w $xr4, $xr12; xvmskltz.w $xr5, $xr13; xvmskltz.w $xr6, $xr14; xvmskltz.w $xr7, $xr15'

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
